summary: The guest, napkin at his neck, looks up from the platter and questions the host's name for the dish.
framing: Medium close-up, eye level, of the guest seated in 3/4 right view, chest up; static camera. Tops of the hamburgers on the platter run along the bottom edge of frame. Blue wall behind, green oval frame cut off at top left; at right a doorway into a lavender room with a green armchair, a lamp on a small table and an oval portrait.

cast.costume: navy suit, white napkin bib tucked in the collar

props: hamburgers on the platter along the bottom edge of frame
red chair back behind the guest's right shoulder
background: green oval frame, green armchair, lamp on side table, oval portrait

beats.action: seated upright, head 3/4 right and tilted down, eyes lowered looking at the burgers, heavy lids, brows flat, mouth closed in a flat line
head starts to lift and turn up toward screen-right
eyes swing up to look right at the host, brows come down level over the eyes
head up and level, steady stare to screen-right, lids heavy, brows low; holds
brows angle down further into a frown, chin drops a touch; keeps staring right
blink: lids half 1977, closed 1978-1979, half 1980, open 1981
same frowning stare to the right, speaking
head lowers slightly, brows relax to level, mouth closes
eyes drop to the platter again, lids heavy, teeth showing in a grimace; held to the cut

notes: Camera static, agrees with timeline.json. On twos, new drawings on odd frames. Only the head moves; shoulders, napkin and hands (out of frame) are a held drawing. No champagne flute is drawn at the left edge in this shot, although the same setup in S27 has one.
